hero.subtitle: A student club at the University of Akli Mohand Oulhadj — Bouira, pushing the boundaries of electronics, robotics, and creative technology, with a language side for English and German.

intro.title: Who We Are
intro.description: AFAQ is a student club where technology, languages, creativity, and teamwork come together. We give students a space to learn, build, and grow, whether that means wiring a robot or holding a conversation in German.

activities.title: Two Sides of AFAQ
activities.sub: One club, two labs: we build with technology and we connect through languages.

workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.desc: Hands-on learning sessions on Arduino, programming, electronics, and more.

robotics.title: Robotics
robotics.desc: Design, build, and program robots for competitions and research.

hackathons.title: Hackathons
hackathons.desc: Intense coding and innovation challenges to solve real problems.

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.desc: Friendly tech competitions to showcase skills and win prizes.

software.title: Software Dev
software.desc: Web, mobile, and systems programming projects with modern tools.

training.title: Training
training.desc: Expert-led workshops and technical training sessions for all levels.

tech.label: Tech Lab
tech.title: We build.
tech.desc: Electronics, robotics, and software, learned by making real things together.

lang.label: Language Lab
lang.title: We speak.
lang.desc: Led by members with strong English and German, the language side helps students study, travel, and work across borders.

english.title: English
english.desc: Speaking, academic writing, and the confidence to present your work.

german.title: German
german.desc: From first words to real conversations, with an eye on study in Germany.

speaking.title: Speaking circles
speaking.desc: Relaxed conversation sessions where everyone gets to talk.

writing.title: Writing & presenting
writing.desc: CVs, emails, reports, and talks, reviewed by experienced members.

culture.title: Culture & exchange
culture.desc: Films, music, and stories that make a language stick.

lang.note: Open to every student, from first words to fluent.
